settings.repere: Texte · How do I switch my dog to Happy Howl?
settings.text: How do I switch my dog to Happy Howl?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Slow and steady keeps tails wagging and
settings.text: Slow and steady keeps tails wagging and tummies happy. Mix Happy Howl into their current food over about 10 days:

settings.repere: Texte · Days 1–3: 25% Happy Howl, 75% current fo
Texte · Days 4–6: 50% Happy Howl, 50% current fo

Texte · Day 11+: 100% Happy Howl. Welcome to the
settings.text: Day 11+: 100% Happy Howl. Welcome to the pack!

settings.repere: Paragraphe · A little change in your pup’s stool is n
settings.text: A little change in your pup’s stool is normal while they adjust to real food. If their tummy needs more time, spend a few extra days at each step.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Three recipes. One standard: real food y
settings.text: Three recipes. One standard: real food you'd recognize in your own kitchen. Every meal is made with 100% human-grade ingredients, single source animal protein, and organ meat in each recipe. Never feed-grade scraps, by-products, or mystery meat.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Each recipe is sealed then gently cooked
settings.text: Each recipe is sealed then gently cooked in our cartons — light- and oxygen-blocking, so it stays fresh and shelf-stable in your pantry with no artificial preservatives, colors, or flavors. No cans, no freezer, no thawing. Because 5-star meals don't require a freezer.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Every order supports our rescue-first mi
settings.text: Every order supports our rescue-first mission — real food that does real good.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Storing. Unopened cartons are shelf-stab
settings.text: Storing. Unopened cartons are shelf-stable — store in a cool, dry pantry, no refrigeration needed. Once opened, cover and refrigerate, and use within the timeframe noted on the carton.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Transitioning. Switch gradually over abo
settings.text: Transitioning. Switch gradually over about 7 days, mixing a little more Happy Howl into your dog's current food each day, to keep digestion happy.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Feeding. Daily amount depends on your do
settings.text: Feeding. Daily amount depends on your dog's weight, age, and activity — use the feeding calculator on this page to dial in the right number of cartons, and check with your vet for dogs with specific needs. As a reference, each carton provides roughly 385–420 calories depending on recipe.
